purpose: An .hdl instance with more nodes than the module's ports is an error (WrongNodeCount). Fewer nodes float the trailing ports (veriloga_trailing_port_floats).

oracle.derivation: An .hdl instance with more nodes than the module's ports is an error (WrongNodeCount). Fewer nodes float the trailing ports (veriloga_trailing_port_floats).

confirmed.command: openvaf-r va_rh.va; ngspice -b with pre_osdi va_rh.osdi and N1 out 0 in vm
confirmed.result: ngspice, which implements Verilog-A instances through OSDI, exits 1: "too many nodes connected to instance".
